text: This Motion authorizes the release of $135,793 of Section 42 funds to contribute to the Ryerson Community School playground revitalization. The Toronto District School Board playground improvement project includes improvements to the play equipment, repaving, seating, plantings, hockey court upgrades, new trails, fencing, and new storage facilities. City funding will allow for the full scope of work to be implemented. The funds will be forwarded to the Toronto District School Board once the Toronto District School Board has entered into a Community Access Agreement with the City governing the purpose of the funds, the financial reporting requirements and addressing community access to the improved facilities. This motion is urgent as Toronto District School Board requires the funds to coordinate with their contractor’s scope of work starting this summer.
